item.title: Rare Drum Electronic Synthesizer HOT ED-42 test
item.description: video upload by nagrzybydolasu This appears to be the first post to feature the HOT ED-42. "This is a little jam with very rare polish drum synthesizer HOT ED-42. Couple of takes (with Roland Tr6s and Moog Dfam) Hot Ed has 4 mono trigger IN/OUT (gate or audio) + 2 mono audio IN channel. All 4 channels sounds the same and has the same parameters (sensitive, decya, sweep, VCO, volume, panorama).
